title: cobblemon re-imagined
description: a cobblemon expirience that is unique to other modpacks
body:
Features offered:
- Performance focused so even potato devices can run 30fps
- multiple end game content such as: Battle towers, expeditions and series changing for a new challange any time you want
- pokemon home to save your pokemon throughout worlds
- frequent updates!!!!
- every mod is carefully picked out and configured so nothing is just "there"

planned features/updates to come:
- custom structures
- complete recipe overhaul
- custom gyms
- legendary and all the pokemon
- quests

we also accept any suggestions you may have so come tell us any!
